name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the user explicitly requests the next APK update.
notes: Phase 344 wraps the Phase 336 poker APIs with a single-fire Android action broker.
Repeated taps of the same action are blocked for 650 ms; NEXT HAND is blocked for 1100 ms.
Accepted actions show one short confirmation and temporarily lock non-seat actions.
The seated-view watchdog waits for sustained drift before recentering the canonical table.
The five-slot community strip is repaired and resynchronized from the Phase 336 state when necessary.
Every hand records observed streets, community-card count, player-hole-card count, action sequence, and winners.
A guided full-hand QA helper can play check/call decisions for up to five hands and report whether preflop through showdown completed with five community cards.
The Phase 343 organized HUD, Phase 342 performance governor, and manual-only APK policy remain preserved.
